uncertain: SOURCE PRECEDENCE: akurasu (source 3) spellings were chosen over licensed English wherever they differ, but several akurasu character pages carry a warning that the name is a fan translation or an editor's choice. The main differences: Roybea Roy (licensed subtitles 'Roabea Loy'; Gundam Wiki 'Roybea Loy'), Tonya Malme (Gundam Wiki 'Toniya Malme'), Sara Tyrell ('Sala Tyrrell'), Tex Farzenburg ('Techcs Farzenberg'), Paula Sis ('Pala Sys'), Enil El ('Ennil El'), Vertigo ('Bertigo'). If the orchestrator prefers the licensed Right Stuf subtitle names, only Roabea Loy and Satelicon are confirmed by a source I could read (Gundam Wiki AWGX page); the others were not verified against the subtitles.
Satelicon: chosen over 'Satyricon' because the Gundam Wiki says the licensed subtitles use Satelicon; akurasu has no entry.

Nomoa (Nomoa Long) and Katokk (Katokk Alzamille): brief proposals 'Nomore' and 'Katock' overridden by the akurasu list; the akurasu list gives no Japanese for the family names, the Gundam Wiki gives カトック・アルザミール and ノモア・ロング.

New UNE / New UNE Forces: abbreviation used by the Gundam Wiki; the full name on akurasu is 'New United Nations Earth'. The Japanese has short and long forms (新連邦 / 新地球連邦); I mapped both to the same body.
colony drop kept lower case; 7th Space War uses a digit as the wiki page title (the game uses ７次).
D.O.M.E. pilot 121 gender recorded 'male' only because the wiki says the entity is a man; the library text treats it as a facility.
Gundam Wiki (fandom) text was fetched through its public API; wikitext quoted as a source, not the licensed subtitles themselves.

Other briefs: 地球連邦 (gundam_2), 新地球連邦軍 (original_1c), コロニーレーザー (gundam_5) appear in X passages; I did not change them but bound X uses with #awgx tokens; コロニーレーザー 'Colony Laser' is compatible with the Gundam Wiki.
